purpose: size the niche Review Outbox lives in, and check whether its positioning is still distinctive

downloads.reading: The 497 lands entirely on the publish day and the neighbouring days read zero for a well-established plugin as well, so the recent zeros are the API's reporting lag, not absence of traffic. The publish-day spike itself cannot be attributed to humans or crawlers from this data.
downloads.notConcluded: no claim is made that 497 people installed it
downloads.benchmarkReading: Neighbouring plugins in this band pull 700-3000 downloads a month, so demand for review/outcome tooling is real and the ceiling is not tiny. Ours sits at the bottom of the band, and its whole figure lands on one publish day, which is at least as consistent with crawlers and mirror pulls as with people.

positioningImplication.contested: session-scoped receipts with version-bound decisions already exist in the catalog
positioningImplication.defensible: evidence-gated approval for research reports — required checks with written evidence for claims, citations, data scope and reproduction, plus same-artifact revision history and an export that states when the bytes moved
positioningImplication.action: lead with the evidence gate in the title, description and first screen; treat the receipt as the artifact that proves the gate was passed, not as the product
